blocks.html: This is documentation authoring platform for Axtroid Documentation ↗.

Prerequisites

Always make sure you have necessary access to work on DocStudio.

NoteBefore you start authoring, please download the stand-aloneDocStudio ↗app.

  1. Once the app is downloaded on to the desktop, click to open the app.
  2. Make sure you see instructions page.
  3. Follow the instructions to set the real-time authoring-environment.
  4. Click ⚙️Settings icon on the top left.
  5. Fill the details as shown below then Click Connect.
    • Owner: Axtroid
    • Repo: documentation
    • Path: docs/index.html
    • Branch: main
    • PAT: (contact admin)
Tip — Personal access token (PAT) is subjected to change, obtain it from your admin.

blocks.text: The application must be restarted to load the latest content from the server.
